concepts.title: AIWF Compatibility Matrix RAG
concepts.summary: A practical compatibility knowledge base for model families, file types, loaders, node support, VRAM tiers, conversion paths, and common mismatch failures.

concepts.title: AIWF Failure Signature Atlas RAG
concepts.summary: A symptom-first troubleshooting RAG organized by visible failure patterns, log signatures, probable causes, and fix order.

concepts.title: AIWF Workflow Pattern Library RAG
concepts.summary: A reusable workflow-structure RAG that stores patterns under JSON workflows so AIWF can build, explain, repair, and teach workflows.

concepts.title: AIWF Source Ledger / Evidence RAG
concepts.summary: An evidence-tracking RAG for where every claim, recommendation, workflow idea, compatibility note, and user test result came from.
